_comment: Defines the niche the editing engine learns from. Discovery searches YouTube for these queries and measures whatever is actually winning, rather than a hand-picked channel list — a competitor we have never heard of teaches us more than one we already watch.
queries: how the cia actually did it
the secret operation nobody knew about
the operation that changed history explained

_notes.min_views: Below this the video is not evidence of anything working.
_notes.duration_band: Long-form only. Shorts compress every structure measured here into 3 seconds and would poison the norms.
_notes.published_after: Editing conventions age. Pre-2023 craft is a different era of the platform.
_notes.queries: Repointed 2026-07-28 from heist/scam to intelligence and covert operations. The lane moved, and a corpus aimed at the old one teaches the channel to copy competitors it no longer has. These queries deliberately favour subjects with no archive footage — an operation nobody filmed has to be built in motion graphics, which is exactly where a channel without an editor cannot follow.
